sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven younger face with short brown temple hair, clear dark eyebrows, serious closed mouth and gaze slightly up toward screen left. Large pale grey fur winter hat with a small blue-white roundel centered on its front; light white-grey snow smock with loose folded hood around neck and visible drawstring/fastener, dark green inner uniform with red gold-edged collar tabs. Brown leather strap descends diagonally at screen right and a long dark-brown rifle rises behind that shoulder, its barrel/sight reaching near the upper edge. Chest-up crop, full pale grey-beige painted backing with fine edge line and soft screen-left lighting; tiny insignia strokes remain unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven mature face, dark eyebrows, closed slightly downturned mouth and short dark temple hair mostly under broad grey fur hat with small blue-white front roundel. Dark green buttoned military tunic with shoulder straps/round gold buttons and red gold-bordered collar tabs with small gold marks; wide brown leather belt crosses from screen-left shoulder, thin binocular neck strap and black/brass binoculars sit partly cropped at bottom center. Retain original crop and soft screen-left light against complete beige-grey backing; tiny collar motifs are pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Young clean-shaven face in pronounced three-quarter turn toward screen left, brown slicked-back short side hair beneath a dark green folded side cap; dark eyebrows and tight closed serious mouth. Cap has a horizontal brown leather strap with small gold buckle and gold strap fittings plus a small red-gold badge above it. Dark green tunic retains red gold-bordered collar tabs, central gold buttons, shoulder straps and narrow multicolored ribbon group on lower screen right. Chest-up crop on full pale grey-beige painted backing, upper-left light; microscopic badge/tab relief cannot be established.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven mature face, short brown hair visible at temples under dark navy peaked cap, separate brown brows and subtle closed half smile. Navy cap has a dark shiny band/visor, gold visor leaf trim and central gold laurel/red pale badge group. Dark navy jacket with broad lapels over white/light-grey pointed shirt collar and black tie, small ribbon group just visible at lower screen right. Retain shoulder/chest crop, light from upper screen left and complete pale cream-grey backing; exact tiny badge relief/ribbon strokes remain unreadable.
